scope: 244 workspace package suites, including 78 language packages; isolated homes, current workspace packages, CI unset.
caveat: The initial full sweep used an earlier frozen JS core. Later retries used the core hashes recorded per run. Package working trees remained live and were not fingerprinted by this suite runner. This is cumulative compatibility evidence, not one immutable full-fleet sweep against the final core hash.

editorSuite.source: Working editor checkout after bulk edits; unrelated changes were also being developed in this checkout.
editorSuite.pendingReason: POSIX process-group termination test is not applicable on Windows.

coreUnitTests.includes: Randomized text geometry and batches, native patch differential checks, marker index and text storage.
